description: This file contains unit tests for the OrderValidator class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing validation logic for Order objects including various validation scenarios and edge cases.

classes.name: OrderValidatorTest
classes.description: Test class for OrderValidator, containing unit tests verifying validation logic for Order objects in various scenarios, including edge cases and field validation.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the orderService before each test.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfOrderIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the Order object is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfOrderAndEncounterHaveDifferentPatients
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if the order's patient does not match the encounter's patient.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDateActivatedIsBeforeEncountersEncounterDatetime
methods.description: Checks that validation detects if 'dateActivated' is before the encounter's datetime.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfVoidedIsNull
methods.description: Verifies validation fails if the 'voided' field is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfConceptIsNull
methods.description: Validates that an error occurs if the 'concept' field is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfPatientIsNull
methods.description: Checks for validation error when the 'patient' is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfOrdererIsNull
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if 'orderer' is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfEncounterIsNull
methods.description: Checks validation error when 'encounter' is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfUrgencyIsNull
methods.description: Ensures validation fails when 'urgency' is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfActionIsNull
methods.description: Verifies validation failure when 'action' is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDateActivatedAfterDateStopped
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if 'dateActivated' is after 'dateStopped'.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfScheduledDateIsNullWhenUrgencyIsON_SCHEDULED_DATE
methods.description: Verifies that scheduledDate must be provided if urgency is ON_SCHEDULED_DATE.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests validation errors for excessively long string fields.

methods.name: saveOrder_shouldNotSaveOrderIfInvalidOrderGroupEncounter
methods.description: Tests that order validation fails for an invalid OrderGroup encounter association.
